Act as the technical lead during complex service interventions and, where required, coordinate field technicians or subcontractors on international projects. Conduct technical audits at customer sites, assess machine condition and identify potential risks or opportunities for improvement. Provide expert technical advice and training to customers on equipment operation, maintenance and safety. Prepare accurate technical reports, checklists and service documentation, including diagnostics, actions taken and recommendations. Share field experience and technical feedback with Engineering and other internal teams to support continuous improvement, product development and innovation. Solid troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across mechanical, electrical, pneumatic and automation systems. Experience with the installation, commissioning, maintenance and technical support of industrial equipment. Ability to work independently, take ownership and make sound technical decisions within established procedures. Strong organizational and documentation skills, with attention to detail when preparing technical reports and service records. Ability to coordinate and support other technicians or subcontractors during complex service interventions. Customer-oriented approach with strong communication and interpersonal skills. review_candidates.title: Facilities & Maintenance Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description MDM Middle East, part of UK-based MDM Props, is a specialist art fabrication and creative production company operating at the intersection of art, design, engineering and fabrication. From concept development and prototyping through fabrication, finishing, logistics and installation, MDM delivers complex, high-quality physical works for major cultural, hospitality, real estate and public-realm projects. Its wider portfolio includes work connected to leading names and institutions such as Guggenheim, Dubai Holding, Aldar, Dior, Louis Vuitton, the V&A, Tate, Ai Weiwei and Jeff Koons . Core sectors include public art, cultural destinations, museums, hospitality, real estate, airports, public realm, exhibitions and leisure attractions . Role Overview MDM Middle East is looking for an experienced and hands-on Facilities & Maintenance Manager to oversee the safe, efficient and reliable operation of our art fabrication multi-story facility. The Facilities & Maintenance Manager is responsible for facilities, utilities, maintenance systems and equipment readiness. The Workshop Manager remains responsible for manpower, production planning, fabrication methods and output. The role covers workshop infrastructure, machinery maintenance, utilities, health and safety coordination, contractor management, security, housekeeping and general site readiness. The Facilities & Maintenance Manager will work closely with production, project management, engineering, logistics and administration teams to keep the workshop safe, compliant, organized and fully operational. This is a practical, site-based position suited to someone comfortable in an active production environment involving metalwork, carpentry, composites, finishing, sculpture fabrication, lifting equipment and other specialist processes. Key Responsibilities Facilities and Workshop Operations • Oversee the daily operation and general condition of the workshop, offices, storage areas, loading zones and external spaces. • Ensure the facility remains clean, organized, secure and suitable for efficient production. • Monitor electrical distribution, water, drainage, ventilation, air-conditioning, lighting, fire systems, paint booths, ovens, extraction, dust collection, compressors, air receivers, generators and other workshop utilities. • Identify facility-related problems early and coordinate repairs before they disrupt production. • Maintain clear access routes, emergency exits, loading areas and designated storage zones. • Support the preparation of workshop areas for new equipment, production processes and major projects. Machinery and Preventive Maintenance • Establish and manage a preventive maintenance programme for workshop machinery, tools, lifting equipment, extraction systems, compressors, generators and other technical assets. • Maintain an equipment register covering serial numbers, manuals, service history, warranties, inspection dates and maintenance requirements. • Coordinate servicing, calibration, certification and repairs with approved suppliers and specialist contractors. • Immediately isolate, label and report defective or unsafe equipment. • Monitor critical spare parts, consumables and maintenance materials, and reduce downtime through planned inspections. review_candidates.description: Chief Investment Officer (Confidential) Location: Doha, Qatar The Opportunity We are conducting a confidential search for an exceptional Chief Investment Officer to lead the investment strategy, investment platform, product innovation, and capital markets activities of a rapidly growing investment business. This is not a traditional portfolio management role. The successful candidate will combine institutional investment expertise with commercial leadership, bringing the ability to design investment products, originate investment opportunities, raise institutional capital, and build scalable investment platforms serving sovereign wealth funds, institutional investors, family offices and high-net-worth clients. The CIO will play a central role in shaping the firm's future investment strategy while partnering closely with Executive Management and the Board to drive long-term growth. Key Responsibilities Investment Strategy & Portfolio Leadership Develop and execute the firm's investment strategy across public and private markets. Lead strategic asset allocation and portfolio construction across multiple asset classes. Provide investment recommendations to Executive Management, Investment Committee and Board. Develop investment policies, governance frameworks and portfolio risk management processes. Monitor macroeconomic developments, capital markets and emerging investment opportunities globally. Investment Platform & Product Development Lead the development, structuring and launch of institutional investment products. Design and oversee: Listed investment funds Private investment funds Alternative investment funds SMAs Co-investment platforms Structured products Bespoke institutional mandates Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Finance and Distribution to successfully commercialize investment solutions. Develop differentiated investment propositions for institutional investors, sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, insurers, family offices and UHNW clients. Partner with distribution teams to support fundraising initiatives, investor presentations and product positioning. Investment Origination & Transaction Execution Lead the sourcing and execution of investment opportunities across multiple asset classes Oversee: Financial modelling Valuation Commercial analysis Due diligence Investment Committee papers Transaction structuring Negotiations Execution Coordinate external advisors including investment banks, legal counsel, consultants and placement agents. Institutional Capital & Commercial Leadership Develop long-term relationships with: Sovereign Wealth Funds Pension Funds Insurance Companies Family Offices Institutional Asset Managers Banks Development Finance Institutions Strategic Partners Support capital raising initiatives through strong institutional engagement. Represent the firm with investors, regulators and industry stakeholders. Identify strategic partnerships and new business opportunities that strengthen the investment platform. Leadership Build and lead a high-performing investment organization. Develop investment professionals across research, portfolio management, product development and investment execution. Promote a culture of disciplined investment decision-making, innovation, collaboration and commercial excellence. Serve as the principal investment adviser to Executive Management and the Board. Candidate Profile The successful candidate will demonstrate experience across most of the following areas: Investment Leadership Leading multi-asset investment strategies Strategic and tactical asset allocation Investment Committee leadership Portfolio construction Investment governance Risk management Listed Funds Demonstrated experience managing, overseeing or launching listed investment funds or publicly traded investment vehicles. Investment Product Development Hands-on experience designing, structuring and launching investment products including institutional funds, alternative investment vehicles, SMAs, structured products or bespoke client mandates. Asset Class Experience Strong experience across several of the following: Public Equities Fixed Income Private Equity Private Credit Infrastructure Real Estate Venture Capital Structured Products Hedge Funds Alternatives Multi-Asset Portfolios Breadth of experience across multiple asset classes is considered highly desirable. Sector Experience Experience investing across multiple sectors including, but not limited to: Financial Services Infrastructure Energy Industrials Technology Healthcare Consumer Real Estate Aviation Logistics Telecommunications Candidates with broad cross-sector investment experience will be preferred. Commercial Capability The ideal candidate will demonstrate the ability to combine investment excellence with commercial execution through: Investment origination Product commercialization Institutional fundraising Client engagement Strategic partnerships Business development Candidates coming from primarily buy-side backgrounds should be able to demonstrate why their experience equips them to successfully lead a commercially focused investment platform with strong institutional client engagement and product development responsibilities. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business or related discipline MBA or Master's degree preferred CFA, CAIA or equivalent professional qualification highly desirable 15+ years of relevant investment experience Proven experience in institutional investment management, investment banking, capital markets, private markets or alternative investments Experience presenting to Boards and Investment Committees Strong institutional network across global investors Critical Competencies Multi-Asset Investment Strategy Investment Product Innovation Listed & Private Fund Management Capital Markets Investment Banking Institutional Capital Raising Investment Origination Portfolio Construction Financial Modelling Transaction Structuring Investment Governance Commercial Leadership Institutional Relationship Management Team Leadership Ideal Background Candidates are likely to come from positions such as: Chief Investment Officer Deputy Chief Investment Officer Global Head of Investment Solutions Global Head of Multi-Asset Managing Director – Investment Banking Managing Director – Capital Markets Managing Director – Infrastructure & Real Assets Head of Institutional Investments Head of Alternatives Head of Product & Investment Solutions Head of Private Markets Head of Asset Management Senior Portfolio Manager (Institutional) Head of Investment Products Partner – Private Equity or Infrastructure Managing Director – Structured Finance Head of Institutional Capital Markets What We Will Be Looking For During the selection process, candidates will be expected to demonstrate: Experience managing or overseeing listed investment funds. A proven track record in designing and launching investment products. Breadth of investment experience across multiple asset classes. Cross-sector investment expertise. The ability to transition investment expertise into a commercially driven investment platform focused on institutional clients, product innovation, and capital formation.
